haiku-low.q1: It still signs them into the same account. Matching is by Google sub, so email is not checked; users.email is never changed by Google.
haiku-low.q2: The user must submit the existing account's password on the confirm page, and it must pass bcrypt. Then the link is inserted and a session is started.
haiku-low.q3: Each wrong password adds to failed_logins. The 5th locks the account for 15 minutes and deletes the pending link, so the user must restart Google sign-in.
haiku-low.q4: Verified email with no matching user: one transaction creates a user with NULL password and the identity, then starts a session. Unverified email: redirect to /login saying to use email and password.
haiku-low.q5: Both fail with the sign-in expired or invalid error page. The attempt record expires after 10 minutes, and GETDEL means a second callback finds nothing. Nothing is written.
haiku-low.q6: start_session creates a new sessions row and a new sid cookie valid 14 days. The old sid's sessions row is deleted, so the previous sid stops working.
haiku-low.q7: Neither a password nor an email match is required. The session user must equal the attempt user_id. If the Google sub is linked to another user, settings shows that the account is linked elsewhere.
haiku-low.q8: In Redis under oidc:attempt:STATE, with a 10 minute TTL. The callback removes it with an atomic GETDEL as its first step, or it expires unused.
haiku-low.q9: In Redis under oidc:pending:ID, holding user_id, google_sub, google_email and next. The browser holds only the random ID in an HttpOnly, Secure pending_link cookie. It is deleted on success or lock, else expires after 10 minutes.
haiku-low.q10: In the PostgreSQL user_identities table. UNIQUE(provider, subject) allows one user per Google account, and UNIQUE(user_id, provider) allows one Google account per user.
haiku-low.q11: The user is redirected to /login with the message Google sign-in failed, try again. The exchange is not retried; the user must start again from the button.
haiku-low.q12: The attempt record's mode field is login or link. For link, the session user must equal the attempt's user_id, otherwise the user gets the sign-in expired or invalid error page.

sonnet.q1: Matching is by sub only, so they land in the same account (sub is in user_identities); the changed email doesn't matter and users.email is never changed. A new session is started.
sonnet.q2: The sub is not linked and email_verified is true, so the user sees 'Confirm your password' (pending record oidc:pending:ID set, pending_link cookie). They must submit the correct password to POST /auth/google/confirm (subject to lockout rules); then user_identities is inserted, pending deleted, and start_session runs.
sonnet.q3: Each wrong password increments failed_logins and the form is shown again. On the 5th wrong, locked_until = now + 15 min and the counter resets; the pending record is deleted and cookie cleared, 'Account temporarily locked' is shown. The user must restart Google sign-in after the lock.
sonnet.q4: Verified email with no matching user: in one transaction a new user is inserted (password_hash NULL, email_verified_at now) plus a user_identities row, then a session starts. If email_verified is false: redirect to /login with 'use email and password'; nothing is written.
sonnet.q5: Both fail: the attempt record (TTL 10 min) has expired or was already consumed by GETDEL, so the user gets an error page 'sign-in expired or invalid, try again'. Nothing is written.
sonnet.q6: start_session(user_id): the old sid's sessions row (if any) is deleted, a new sessions row is inserted, and a new sid cookie is set (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, 14 days, slid forward on use). Then redirect to next if a relative path on the site, else /home.
sonnet.q7: No password and no email match is required; emails may differ. If the Google sub is already linked to another user, Settings shows that this Google account is linked to another account and nothing is inserted. (If linked to this same user, 'already linked'.)
sonnet.q8: In Redis under oidc:attempt:<state> with a 10 min TTL (also mode, user_id, next). The callback deletes it with an atomic GETDEL as its first step; if unused it expires.
sonnet.q9: In Redis at oidc:pending:<id> (TTL 10 min) holding user_id, google_sub, google_email and next. The browser holds only the random id in an HttpOnly, Secure pending_link cookie. It is deleted when the link succeeds or the account locks, otherwise it expires.
sonnet.q10: In the new PostgreSQL table user_identities (user_id, provider='google', subject=Google sub, email_at_link, linked_at). UNIQUE(provider, subject) gives one user per Google account; UNIQUE(user_id, provider) gives one Google account per user.
sonnet.q11: The user is redirected to /login with 'Google sign-in failed, try again'. The exchange is not retried (code is single-use and the attempt record is gone); the user starts again from the button. Nothing is written.
sonnet.q12: The attempt record's mode field (login or link) read in the callback. For link, the record stores user_id, and the callback checks that the current session user equals that user_id; if not, it shows the error 'sign-in expired or invalid' page and nothing is linked.
